mapper.sql: deleted_at is null and status = 'active' and ( lower(username) like lower(concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) or lower(display_name) like lower(concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) )
mapper.update: update app_user set username = #{entity.username}, phone = #{entity.phone}, email = #{entity.email}, password_hash = #{entity.passwordHash}, display_name = #{entity.displayName}, avatar_url = #{entity.avatarUrl}, status = #{entity.status}, last_login_at = #{entity.lastLoginAt}, created_at = #{entity.createdAt}, updated_at = #{entity.updatedAt}, deleted_at = #{entity.deletedAt} where id = #{entity.id}
mapper.select: select * from app_user where deleted_at is null and ( lower(username) = lower(#{account}) or lower(coalesce(email, '')) = lower(#{account}) or coalesce(phone, '') = #{account} ) order by id asc limit 1
select * from app_user order by id asc
